rows.intro: Shopping is everything, everywhere, all at once.

seoMetadata.description: Discover how AI transforms commerce with personalized shopping, predictive marketing, and integrated online-offline retail. Explore what’s next today.
seoMetadata.title: Commerce & AI: Personalized Shopping Experiences

rows.title: Commerce
values:
Traditional advertising channels are dying, just as today’s customers expect total personalization. 

Predictive technologies and personalized marketing tools arm sellers with cloud-based, ML-centric tools to market more authentically and reap the rewards.

Generative AI will drive a new wave of shopping experiences – think: unlimited content creation, personalized product search and recommendations, customer feedback at scale, and better inventory forecasting.

The future of in-person shopping is completely integrated with online shopping. 

Tomorrow’s brick and mortar shops are an extension of the online experience, offering increased workforce productivity, a better buying experience and customer-level insights.

rows.intro: The smart money is on money getting smarter.

seoMetadata.description: Explore how AI is transforming fintech, ERP, and banking systems. Discover smarter finance operations and embedded finance. Learn more today.
seoMetadata.title: Fintech AI: Smarter Money, Smarter Finance Systems

rows.title: Fintech
values: AI is starting to rewrite the financial operating systems across financial institutions and the office of the CFO. Finance teams are due for a major AI-enabled upgrade to their ERP, core banking systems, FP&A tools, etc.

The AI revolution doesn’t stop at the front end systems, but is also augmenting human processes that hold finance operating systems together. We see AI taking over functions like compliance, fraud, collection operations as automating the roles of knowledge workers around the core fintech systems.

Finance is continuing to dissolve into the software layer turning many platforms into banks. We see the introduction of banking, stablecoin, and personal finance tooling as a distribution superpower that all software platforms can tap into.
